nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## About this workflow

This template runs the **Image to Video** task (`MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo` node), which covers both:

- **t2va** (text-to-video), when no images are connected
- **fl2va** (first/last-frame image-to-video), when `first_frame` and/or `last_frame` are connected

**Key inputs**

- **first_frame / last_frame**: optional keyframes; the model generates the motion between them
- **prompt**: describe the shots, motion, and the accompanying audio (dialogue, SFX, music) in one block
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector. H3's native canvas is a 768px short edge, capped at 768x1344 pixels, rounded to a multiple of 32
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node, snapping up to the model's 17-frame-per-block (17k+5) grid at 24fps

subject_definitions:
<Subject 1>: Character 1, a man — the one individual shown in the Character 1 reference photographs (<Picture 1>). Face, facial features, hair, skin and build come only from those photographs and stay identical in every shot, at every distance and through every camera move. Wears, unchanged from the first frame to the last: A narrow strip of dark brown leather cinches his waist, holding a small, worn leather pouch; he wears no visible top or bottom garment, and has no footwear, headwear, or jewellery.
<Subject 2>: Character 2, a woman — the one individual shown in the Character 2 reference photographs (<Picture 2>). Face, facial features, hair, skin and build come only from those photographs and stay identical in every shot, at every distance and through every camera move. Wears, unchanged from the first frame to the last: A ragged, rough linen skirt of off-white covers her lower body, and she wears no top, gloves, footwear, or headwear, though her dark hair is bound with thin strips of brown leather.
<Environment>: Exterior. The Sands of Triumph Arena, in the afternoon, in full daylight, scorching, harsh sunlight.

summary:
[reference generation] The exchange sees <Subject 2> execute a violent rotational spin, launching a massive sweeping cut that severs through the space where <Subject 1>'s neck is; the clip ends mid-roll as <Subject 1> violently throws his weight backward to escape the blow.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1> → <Subject 1>: partially_preserved, throughout the clip — identity (face, facial features, hair, skin, build) is kept; clothing follows subject_definitions. The photograph's plain studio backdrop, neutral standing pose, framing and any panel layout are not carried into the video, and it is never a frame of it.
<Picture 2> → <Subject 2>: partially_preserved, throughout the clip — identity (face, facial features, hair, skin, build) is kept; clothing follows subject_definitions. The photograph's plain studio backdrop, neutral standing pose, framing and any panel layout are not carried into the video, and it is never a frame of it.
<Environment>, composition, camera, action, physical effects and lighting: newly_generated from detailed_description.
Audio: newly_generated — there is no reference audio.

detailed_description:
Live-action, 35mm five-grain film. A low-angle wide two-shot establishes the massive sand arena under scorching, harsh afternoon sunlight, holding <Subject 1>, wearing A narrow strip of dark brown leather that cinches his waist with a small, worn leather pouch, on screen-left; and <Subject 2>, wears A ragged, rough linen skirt of off white, on screen-right. Both subjects are positioned slightly less than one stride apart, locked in fierce eye contact, their bodies held three-quarter to the frame. <Subject 2> begins from a slight crouch following the previous impact, then initiates an explosive, wide rotational spin toward screen-left while maintaining her upper body facing forward; as she spins, she channels her entire momentum into a massive, sweeping overhead cut aimed directly at the center mass of <Subject 1>'; as the blade arcs through the air, <Subject 1> reacts by throwing his torso violently backward and simultaneously pivoting his legs to roll away from the trajectory, attempting to avoid the fatal strike; the camera tracks rapidly in an arc around both subjects at high speed, keeping <Subject 2> centered while following the path of her spinning blade, emphasizing the sweep's power across the frame. At the precise point of contact—when the sword edge slices past the target zone—a brilliant spray of dark, crimson blood explodes outwards from <Subject 1>'s collarbone area, instantly catching the harsh sun in a dazzling flare; simultaneously, <Subject 2>'s momentum drives her torso fully through the rotation, and <Subject 1>'s arms fling out wide in a desperate block/deflection against the incoming cut. The shot concludes with both subjects still in motion: <Subject 2> settling her spin to a powerful stance, momentarily leaning into the impact zone, while <Subject 1> is mid-roll, his back arched and weight driving him backward toward the arena sand.

[Shot 1] At N/A, a low-angle medium wide two-shot holds both subjects in the dynamic rotational sequence established above: <Subject 2> pivots fully to screen-left, her sword raised high overhead, and <Subject 1> initiates his powerful backwards roll from a braced stance toward screen-right. The camera begins its rapid arc motion tracking around them at high velocity, maintaining a slightly wide composition to show the sweeping reach of the blow; <Subject 2> continuously drives the blade downward and across her body while simultaneously rotating through her hips, forcing <Subject 1> into his horizontal, rebounding posture; at the moment the blade cleanly separates from its initial line and connects with flesh, the brilliant crimson spray explodes outward in a defined arc towards screen-right; <Subject 1>'s left arm throws wide to meet the blow, and <Subject 2>'s facial muscles tighten severely as she completes her rotation. The shot ends with both fighters mid-action: <Subject 2> having stabilized her spin into a strong facing posture, while <Subject 1>'s back is fully arched above the sand, his momentum carrying him away from the blow.

[Shot 2] At 00:10.000 (Note: The shot runs to 10s and ends mid-motion towards the next beat), a medium close-up transitions focus solely to <Subject 1> on screen-left. He is captured mid-roll, still fully inverted relative to his starting posture, and his head is whipping across the frame toward the right; <Subject 2>'s presence is felt just over his shoulder as she settles her weight slightly forward, readying her follow-up; <Subject 1> maintains a desperate horizontal momentum as he rolls through the apex of his evasion, then begins to drive his center of gravity backward along the sand; at the precise instant his head passes his starting vertical axis, the blood spray continues to drip and speckle onto the dusty arena floor immediately beneath him, catching the harsh light; <Subject 1>'s wide-flung left arm swings forward, attempting a final desperate guard position. The shot ends with his body halfway through its roll—his right knee lifting highest off the ground—while his gaze is fixed intensely toward <Subject 2> as the sword continues its descent path into the empty space where his neck was.

overall_soundscape:
The constant, loud roar of the afternoon crowd remains the ambient baseline, punctuated by the gritty *shhhh* sound of sand being displaced by the rapid rotation; a tremendous, ripping *SCHWIIIING* cuts through the noise as <Subject 2>'s sword cleaves the air during the arc; this is immediately followed by a wet, heavy *SPLAT-THUNK* as the blood sprays onto the ground and hits the dirt; finally, a deep, ragged *HUUFF* of strained breath escapes <Subject 1>'s lungs as his torso fully commits to the backward roll.

non_diegetic_music:
The deep strings continue their tense minor foundation, but the violin lines swell into a frantic, soaring crescendo that mirrors the rotational speed of <Subject 2>'; the percussion hits become more complex, introducing rapid rolls on the snare drum synchronized with the sword's sweep, reaching peak intensity as <Subject 1> lands in his roll.
